GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Knuckled on jumping, missed the start and Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 12 Lengths turning, made up ground in Straight # missed the start
Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field 3 Wide 5 Lengths 500m, Ridden Along before the corner, was Just one paced in Straight and did not finish race off well enough # one paced
